description: Handoff automatic checkpoint hook for Codex CLI

hooks.command: for d in "$HOME/.nvm/versions/node"/*/bin "$HOME/.fnm/node-versions"/*/installation/bin "$HOME/.asdf/installs/nodejs"/*/bin /opt/homebrew/bin /usr/local/bin "$HOME/.local/bin" "$HOME/.volta/bin"; do [ -x "$d/node" ] && exec "$d/node" "$HOME/.handoff/plugin/hooks/codex-checkpoint.js"; done; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec node "$HOME/.handoff/plugin/hooks/codex-checkpoint.js"; exit 0
